metadata.title: भूना महुआ और तिल का रसपुटका । How to make healthy snacks with Mahua । The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
Adivasis (Tribal Population) have a very close connection with the jungles around them. They collect many forest produce from them, with  Mahua being one of them. There is a general perception that Adivasis make local wine from Mahua, which is true, but not many people know that Adivasis make many more things using this wild fruit. In this episode, we show you how Mahua is used for making different dishes in Tribal India.
